purpose: Reconstruct rookie-pick value as of a historical trade timestamp using only evidence knowable at or before that timestamp.

hard_exclusions.startup_2022: Sleeper startup picks were nomination/order mechanics and have zero rookie-pick valuation authority.

cases.current_year_exact_slot_known: Use exact slot only when the historical knowledge boundary proves it was known.
cases.current_year_unresolved: Use a point-in-time slot distribution and explicit uncertainty.
cases.future_year: Use round, horizon, historical team-state slot distribution and bounded time sensitivity.
cases.hindsight_known_today: May be used only later to evaluate reconstruction quality, never as decision-time input.

evidence_quality.HIGH: Exact known slot plus at least two prior completed FSFFL rookie drafts.
evidence_quality.MEDIUM: Unresolved slot with credible point-in-time distribution plus at least two prior completed rookie drafts.
evidence_quality.LOW: Sparse prior evidence or broad unresolved uncertainty; sensitivity only.
evidence_quality.EXCLUDED: Leakage, startup mechanics, non-comparable semantics, or unsupported round.
